sub_sector.value: Oilfield specialty chemicals; oil and gas analytics

manufacturing_type.detail: Operates chemical production facilities and supplies standard base products and bespoke finished blends.

production_model.detail: Formulates customized fluid systems after analyzing the customer's reservoir, then delivers the tailored design to the wellsite.

product_complexity.detail: Engineers reservoir-specific fluid systems and specialty additives, and develops real-time measurement and analytics technology.

production_role.detail: Produces specialty chemicals and supplies tailored fluid systems directly to operators or through their preferred service providers.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves oil and gas drilling, completions and production, plus midstream and downstream measurement and mobile power generation.

notes: The evidence leaves inventory practices for standard base products unclear.
